title: Base Operating Support Services at Cooperative Security Location Comalapa, El Salvador
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVFAC.NAVFAC ATLANTIC CMD.NAVFAC SOUTHEAST.NAVFACSYSCOM SOUTHEAST
detail_text: The outcomes to be achieved are Base Operating Support Services at Cooperative Security Location (CSL) Comalapa, EL Salvador. This acquisition will provide base support services for IT Support and Management, Force Protection, Airfield Facilities, Material Management, Facility Investment, Custodial, Pest Control, Integrated Solid Waste Management (ISWM), Grounds Maintenance and Landscaping, Base Support Vehicle and Equipment, and Environmental Services. The outcomes for this acquisition are consistent with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 37.001 definition of service contracts.
